$description: Lumen v0.13 — RESTRAINED mode rebind set. Restrained is the default and is empty by design — no token rebinds happen here. The semantic tokens at `color.surface.*`, `color.text.*`, `color.border.*`, `color.action.*` already encode the restrained voice (dense surfaces, hairline frames, no glass on canvas/table/row/cell, atmosphere muted to 4–6% if any). This file exists as the explicit mode-route placeholder: a Style Dictionary build can target `[data-mode='restrained']` scope here without having to special-case the no-overrides case. Phase 1 will fill expressive.tokens.json; restrained stays a thin placeholder.

name.$description: v0.13 — the default mode. Used for SaaS dashboards, tables, settings, terminals, command palette, every dense operator surface.

atmosphere.$description: Restrained surfaces drop all ambient atmosphere — no aurora, no mesh, no grain. Hairline-frame + content-only.

glass-policy.$description: backdrop-filter is only legal on floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, nav). NEVER on canvas, table, row, cell.

motion-policy.$description: All transitions use motion.easing.decelerate (the Lumen default). Bounce + emphasised reserved for celebration moments only.
